title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.05.1
notes:
- Original, Clean Modern and Analog are available in Options > Theme settings > Full mixer style. Original is the default, with colored molded knobs, ribbed faders and cream VU meters behind curved glass.
- Drag a fade handle on a selected Playlist audio clip to edit the same edge across selected audio clips. Each fade respects its clip length and opposite fade. One undo restores the group edit.
- Tape drive adds progressively stronger saturation, pitch drift, flutter and hiss on a single stereo-linked tape path.
- The plugin picker has searchable preview cards, favorites, an Installed filter for external plugins, sorting, a detail panel and a Choose button. Select a card to inspect it, double-click to load it or drag it into place.
- Channel Rack step buttons have raised edges and a recessed active state.
- The Piano Roll displays the current key and scale in separate quick selectors.
- Lemon Sampler opens with its mixer-routing controls visible by default.

https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/
